disambiguation: Not a Mermaid code formatter; it only switches which engine renders the diagram.
extras: Warns that pele has known rendering quirks documented upstream, and that the plugin conflicts with beautiful-mermaid-renderer; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Conflicts with beautiful-mermaid-renderer — disable that plugin if both are installed
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid fences with only its built-in engine, so unsupported diagram types error and the visual style cannot be changed per diagram.
